ui.逆向执行最后一条仍可撤销的变更并登记日志。dryRun 只预览。seq 已过期时: Undo the last change of a game’s log not undone yet: its inverse run as a changeset, checked, and logged as an undo (dryRun: preview only). seq: the change the caller means (log gives it as undoable): refused when that is no longer the one undo would undo.
ui.逐项执行变更集并检查整个目标。全部通过才写入，dryRun 只预览。base 是: Apply a changeset { why?, by?, ops: [{ op, …args }] } to a game (by: who makes it, e.g. agent:<step>:<model>; the change log keeps it): every op checked and run, the whole game checked; written only when nothing fails (dryRun: preview only). base: the seq of the log’s last entry the caller saw (preview and log give it as head): refused when the game has changed since.
